events.title: Welcome!
events.summary: Hello, archers! At its heart, Idle Archery is about taking one simple shot and turning it into an entire money making range. Destroy targets, hire archers, unlock tougher and more valuable targets, stack upgrades, tune your priorities, and prestige for permanent talents that make every new run snowball faster.
